author: CNN
description:
CNN’s Fareed Zakaria compares Donald Trump’s first term in office to his second, less-constrained presidency. Without the staffing guardrails that existed in Trump 1.0, Trump 2.0 has exhibited an increased comfort level with monetizing the presidency. Fareed examines what it would take to prevent personal enrichment in future presidencies.

Also, Fareed speaks with New York Times chief political analyst, Nate Cohn, about why Trump isn't backing down in the face of low approval ratings.

Watch more CNN here: https://cnn.it/4kh5RPe

#News
title: Can Trump’s brazen pursuit of WH enrichment be stopped? | Fareed’s Take

author: CNN
description:
As officials in Southern California race to cool down a massive tank filled with a toxic chemical at risk of explosion, tens of thousands of nearby residents have been forced to leave their homes due to health concerns and the risk of catastrophic damage if there is a blast. 

About 50,000 people in Orange County have been told to evacuate, with many spending the Memorial Day weekend in shelters, hotels or with friends and family outside the danger zone. 

CNN’s Veronica Miracle has more from Los Angeles. Also, Cal State Long Beach chemistry & biochemistry lecturer Elaine Bernal and EPA administrator Lee Zeldin give more details on the threat.

0:00 CNN correspondent details the chemical explosion threat in southern California 
2:59 Chemical expert explains what is causing the temperature to rise inside the chemical tank 
8:18 EPA administrator describes the emergency response 

Watch more CNN here: https://cnn.it/4kh5RPe

#California #ChemicalTank #News
title: CA chemical explosion threat: 50,000 told to evacuate

author: CNN
description:
Secret Service officers shot and killed a person who the agency said approached a security checkpoint Saturday near the White House and fired at them. 

Shortly before 6 p.m. ET, an individual approached a checkpoint just outside the White House complex and began firing at officers, a Secret Service spokesperson said, citing a preliminary investigation. 

CNN’s Julia Benbrook describes the moment she heard shots and was ushered into lockdown in the White House press briefing room. Also, CNN’s Brian Todd has more from the scene of the shooting and CNN law enforcement analyst Jonathan Wackrow details the Secret Service response. 

0:00 Video shows the moment reporters heard gunshots outside the White House 
1:00 CNN correspondent describes what she heard 
2:30 CNN’s Brian Todd has the latest on the shooter and President Trump’s response 
5:45 CNN law enforcement analyst breaks down the Secret Service response 

Watch more CNN here: https://cnn.it/4kh5RPe

#WhiteHouse #Trump #News
title: White House shooting: CNN reporter describes moment shots rang out
